# Cozyland Studio

> Cozyland Studio is an AI-powered podcast creation and interactive 3D explainer web application. From a single line, article, or URL, dual conversational hosts (Riya and Arjun) generate grounded scripts, spoken multilingual audio across 14 languages, custom cover artwork, and interactive Three.js concept scenes.

Public documentation and capability manifests for Cozyland Studio are listed below. API endpoints require interactive session requests and exclude private runtime secrets.

## Public Application
- [Cozyland Studio Web App](https://cozyland.ai.studio/): Create multilingual two-host AI podcasts, inspect synchronized transcripts, and explore interactive 3D concept explainers.
- [Sitemap](https://cozyland.ai.studio/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap of public Cozyland Studio routes.
- [Robots Policy](https://cozyland.ai.studio/robots.txt): Crawler access rules for search engines and automated agents.

## Machine-Readable Discovery
- [AI Catalog Manifest](https://cozyland.ai.studio/.well-known/ai-catalog.json): Standardized Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) JSON manifest describing Cozyland Studio's public capabilities.
- [AI Catalog Alias](https://cozyland.ai.studio/ai-catalog.json): Root-path copy of the Cozyland Studio AI Catalog Manifest.
